# RESOLVED Search PDF results showing mix of upper and lower characters in Serial Number parameter

_Category: Known Bugs · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**pheath** (1/26/2022):

When performing a Serial Number search, the parameter value entered for the search will display in the PDF  with any string of characters as a capitalized word.  (Ex.  1gks2MRHSFD3ujer273649 will appear in the report as 1Gks2Mhrhsfd3Ujer273649)

Zenhub ticket 10781 has been created to resolve this issue.

---

**Melissa** (1/27/2022):

The fix to resolve this issue was implemented January 26th.
